chunks: I have put out the eye of revolt, and no one except me advanced towards it when its gloom was swelling and its madness was intense. Ask me before you miss me,

by Allah, who has my life in His hands, if you ask me anything between now and the Day of Judgement or about the group who would guide a hundred people and also misguide a hundred people, I would tell you who is announcing its march, who is driving it in the front and who is driving it at the rear,
the stages where its riding animals would stop for rest and the final place of stay, and who among them would be killed and who would die a natural death.

key_terms.سَائِقِهَا: its driver/pusher (one who drives it forward from behind)
key_terms.عَيْنَ الْفِتْنَةِ: the eye of revolt (metaphor for the initial outbreak or key figure of the Kharijite rebellion)
key_terms.فِئَةٍ: a faction/group (referring to a specific political-religious group)
key_terms.نَاعِقِهَا: its announcer/marcher (one who signals the movement)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali promise to reveal about the Kharijites and the group that guides and misguides?
ai.summary: In this famous declaration, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) asserts his comprehensive knowledge of the future, specifically targeting the Kharijites whom he metaphorically calls 'the eye of the fitna' (trial/chaos). He invites the people to question him about the details of the faction that will guide and misguide equal numbers, promising to reveal their leaders, stages, and ultimate fate before his death. This statement underscores the Shia belief in the Imam's divine knowledge of eschatological events and the specific dynamics of the Kharijite movement.

en.sayed-ali-raza: So now, praise and eulogy be to Allah, O people,
I have put out the eye of revolt. No one except me advanced towards it when its gloom was swelling and its madness was intense. Ask me before you miss me,

[2] because, by Allah, who has my life in His hands, if you ask me anything between now and the Day of Judgement or about the group who would guide a hundred people and also misguide a hundred people I would tell you who is announcing its march, who is driving it in the front and who is driving it at the rear,
the stages where its riding animals would stop for rest and the final place of stay, and who among them would be killed and who would die a natural death.
